visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a white collared shirt and a beige vest, stands in a brightly lit indoor bathroom. She smiles at the camera, gesturing with her hands. The background features tiled walls and a wooden door frame. (2) She holds up a white circular cotton pad. A text overlay identifies it as a DRX product. She points to her forehead, indicating a small red pimple. Her expression is focused as she explains. (3) Close-up shot as she wipes the cotton pad across her forehead and nose. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her skin texture. (4) She holds a sleek white bottle with a gold cap. She pumps a liquid product onto the palm of her hand. Her hands are steady and the bottle is clearly visible. (5) She applies a white cream to her cheeks and forehead using the applicator of another white bottle. She looks directly into the camera/mirror. (6) She rubs the white cream into her face with her hands. The cream initially leaves a white cast before being absorbed. She is wearing a gold necklace. (7) She puts on a pair of round-rimmed glasses and applies red lipstick from a black tube. She leans closer to the camera. (8) She waves goodbye to the camera with a cheerful expression. (9) A final screen displays the brand logo 'DR 達特仕保養品' on a light grey background with abstract wavy lines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in an upbeat and informative tone in Traditional Chinese, explaining her morning skincare routine. A bright, mid-tempo acoustic background track featuring piano and guitar starts immediately. (2) Vocal inflection rises as she highlights a specific pimple, maintaining high clarity and engagement. Subtle digital sound effects accompany text pop-ups on screen. (3) The BGM continues steadily, providing a rhythmic base for the constant narration. No environmental noise is present; the audio is very clean and studio-processed. (4) The speaker's delivery speed is fast but clear, detailing product benefits like 'antioxidant' and 'whitening'. (5) The audio track transitions cleanly into a final sign-off with a friendly 'bye', and the BGM fades out during the end-screen logo.
